keyEvents.text: Goal! PSV Eindhoven 1, Willem II 0. Mauro Júnior (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Maxim Dekker (Willem II) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 2, Willem II 0. Guus Til (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Armando Obispo following a corner.
First Half ends, PSV Eindhoven 2, Willem II 0.
Second Half begins PSV Eindhoven 2, Willem II 0.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 3, Willem II 0. Sven Mijnans (PSV Eindhoven) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Sergiño Dest.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 4, Willem II 0. Ruben van Bommel (PSV Eindhoven) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Sven Mijnans with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Noah Fernandez replaces Mauro Júnior.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ricardo Pepi replaces Ivan Perisic.
Substitution, Willem II. Per van Loon replaces Hidde ter Avest.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ayoni Santos replaces Ruben van Bommel.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Esmir Bajraktarevic replaces Sergiño Dest.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 5, Willem II 0. Ricardo Pepi (PSV Eindhoven) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Esmir Bajraktarevic with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Willem II. Kasper Boogaard replaces Anass Zarrouk.
Substitution, Willem II. Tonny Vilhena replaces Vito van Crooij.
Finn Stam (Willem II) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 6, Willem II 0. Kodai Sano (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ricardo Pepi.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Shuryjano Cornecion replaces Guus Til.
Substitution, Willem II. Alessandro Ciranni replaces Uriel van Aalst.
Substitution, Willem II. Amine Et-Taïbi replaces Finn Stam.
Goal! PSV Eindhoven 7, Willem II 0. Shuryjano Cornecion (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom left corner.
Second Half ends, PSV Eindhoven 7, Willem II 0.
